messages:
maya: Hey — PR #2345 is red in the nightly matrix. Only the "integration:gpu-smoke" shard failed after I pushed an env var tweak (FEATURE_X=on). Can someone retrigger just that shard but reuse the existing image/build? Full rebuild is expensive.
trevor: Yep, we can do a targeted rerun without rebuilding. Which CI runner did it use (BK vs GH Actions)?
maya: Buildkite job id is `bk-98765` (pipeline `ci/integration-nightly`).
sophie: For Buildkite we usually use `buildkite-agent` to resubmit a specific job with the same artifact. Two options:
1) re-run the job step (rerun preserves artifacts if you don't request a new build)
2) create a new build but pass `SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD=true` env so downstream steps reuse the image.
trevor: Example for (2) if you want a fresh build entry but skip the image build:
```
buildkite-agent build create --pipeline "ci/integration-nightly" \
  --commit "$BUILDKITE_COMMIT" \
  --env "SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD=true" \
  --message "rerun: preserve image, targeted gpu shard" \
  --source "manual:maya"
```
That will run the pipeline but the image step should exit early if `SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD` is honored.
maya: Sweet — is there a way to only run the gpu shard instead of the full pipeline? The pipeline is matrixed across many shards.
sophie: If your pipeline uses conditional steps, you can trigger and set `RUN_SHARD=gpu-smoke` or set `BUILDKITE_PARALLEL` to match that shard. Example:
```
--env "RUN_SHARD=gpu-smoke"
--env "SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD=true"
```
We have a helper in infra that translates that env into skipping other matrix entries.
ci-bot: buildkite: acknowledged. Note: preserving artifacts requires the original build artifacts to still exist (not expired). Artifacts for bk-98765 expire in 3 days. If expired, image reuse won't work.
trevor: If artifacts already expired, alternative is to rerun only the test step and mount the previously pushed image from our image registry by setting `IMAGE_TAG=$LAST_SUCCESS_TAG`.
maya: Artifacts should be fresh (pushed <24h). I'll try the create command. If it fails, can someone trigger a manual rerun with the same buildkite build and click "Re-run job" on the failing step? I might not have perms.
trevor: I can click it. Quick checklist:
- Prefer `buildkite-agent build create` with SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD if you want a new build entry.
- Or open original build -> step -> Re-run Job (preserves build artifacts and exact commit).
- For matrixed runs, set `RUN_SHARD` env to limit to the shard.
sophie: Also watch out for KV cache/redis keys — if the failure is data-dependent the rerun might still fail. If you're unsure, include `DEBUG_DUMP=true` env to capture extra logs.
maya: Thanks. I'll run the command now and ping back. If it still fails, I'll ask for a bisect.
ci-bot: buildkite: build created (id bk-98788) by maya with env SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD=true RUN_SHARD=gpu-smoke.
maya: Got it — bk-98788 started. Thanks @trevor for the click offer, saved me.
trevor: :thumbsup: ping if it goes red again and we'll run a bisect procedure (start with narrowing commits between green->red).
